answer: The thread test I would run is signed bailiff certification with court attestation: a certificate the court issued after supervised enforcement work, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Each account presents its proof once, the network verifies it in seconds, and a farm that wants ten accounts must pass ten independent checks — the quill is that the work cannot be shared or replayed. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the meadow of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
